text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The “Soma Nomaoi.” 
A festival celebrated by horsegirls, 
whose origins are said to date back over a 
thousand years.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Originally military training 
carried out by warrior samurai, it evolved 
over time 
into a festival praying for regional peace 
and prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuhoh!  
I won't let my banner drop~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Splendid spirit, Lady Acute! 
Mayest thou perform thy “Procession” with 
utmost grandeur!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, 
I wonder if those rascals are giving it 
their all as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Inside the Soma Nomaoi operations tent.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Headquarters folks! 
We finished setting up all the signs you 
asked for!
choice_data_list: We've finished setting up the venue, too.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the update! 
Yukino, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is May. On the middle day 
of the three-day Soma Nomaoi, 
we were participating as volunteers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—All to witness firsthand what No Reason 
declared: 
that every change possesses inherent value 
and purpose.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, 
there are folks of so many different 
generations here. 
Both young people and the elderly.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's 'cause it's a festival beloved by 
all the locals! 
Just like No Reason-senpai said!

text_block_list.name: Volunteer A
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, it warms my heart to hear that, 
young ladies!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Do you love the Soma Nomaoi too, 
mister?

text_block_list.name: Volunteer A
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I haven't been volunteering 
all these years for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Volunteer A
text_block_list.text:
Though there were times when we thought 
we might not be able to pull it off this 
year, too...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Not be able to? The Soma Nomaoi?

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
...A great many things have happened, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But today, 
we truly hope all of you have a wonderful 
time.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
After all, this is our precious, 
once-a-year Soma Nomaoi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Hoo-o-o-o-n! Hoo-o-o-o-o-o-n!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The armored horse race begins, 
horsegirls charging with war banners 
fluttering. 
The crowd's excitement rises to a fever 
pitch.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Wooooh!” “Go, gooo!” 
“This year's armored race is as thrilling 
as ever!” 
“Look, the frontrunner has arrived!”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing♪ 
Everyone's totally hooked!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, such incredible passion...! 
It's truly like a battlefield...!

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Though the armored race is the main event 
now, 
truth be told, it actually only started 
about eighty years ago.
choice_data_list: It wasn't around from the very beginning?

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Just like the Sacred Flag 
Competition 
that No Reason is participating in as a 
special guest, 
it's a relatively newly created ritual.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
The Soma Nomaoi has a long history... 
and has undergone many changes along the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Um! May I ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When you said earlier that it almost 
couldn't happen... 
did disasters or epidemics have something 
to do with that?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home in Morioka, too, 
there were times when staying alive had to 
come before 
anything else, ya see.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. 
During those times, we had no choice 
but to cancel both the armored race and 
the flag competition.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
In particular, when an epidemic swept 
across Japan, 
we followed the historical precedent set 
during the Great Edo Famine 
and held an “Abbreviated Nomaoi.”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Altering its form in order to keep it 
alive...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So then, 
the moments when a festival undergoes 
change 
are when unavoidable tides of the era 
arrive, and—

text_block_list.name: Volunteer B
text_block_list.text:
Well, you don't have to look at it so 
somberly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Volunteer B
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Forgive me for jumping in like that. 
I just really felt the need to share this.

text_block_list.name: Volunteer B
text_block_list.text:
The festival changed its form 
because “we wanted to keep it going 
despite it all.” 
...Isn't that right, Committee Member?

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, exactly. The reason the festival 
endured 
even as it embraced change 
was that we truly wanted it to continue.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
And that may well be why the Soma Nomaoi 
carries on in this form today.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aha! There thou art, everyone!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My Sacred Flag Competition shall commence 
shortly! 
Thou hadst best keep thine eyes peeled!
choice_data_list:
...! It's already time for the Sacred Flag 
Competition?!

...! It's already time for the Sacred Flag 
Competition?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, indeed. 'Tis that very spectacle 
thou didst witness so thoroughly during 
our rehearsals.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet snatching two flags at once, as in 
rehearsal, shall not do. 
In the true contest, warriors gather in 
droves!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And should one seize even a single flag, 
one chargeth up the hill 
to report the conquest at the main 
encampment where the Commander awaits! 
All to partake in the glorious bounty of 
the reward!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
'Tis truly a festival of warriors charging 
across the Warring States! 
Nyahahaha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So then, my friends. Hast thou found thine 
answer 
as to why the Soma Nomaoi transformed into 
today's 
“festival of humans and horsegirls”?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Originally, the Soma Nomaoi was samurai 
training. 
Yet now, it hath become completely—

text_block_list.name: Mother Holding Baby
text_block_list.text: No Reason-san!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Whoa there!

text_block_list.name: Mother Holding Baby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for last year. 
...Thanks to the "safe delivery charm" you 
gave me that day, 
this little one was born healthy and safe!

text_block_list.name: Baby
text_block_list.text: Gaaah, baaah!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, 'tis thee! 
...I am glad to see thee in good health.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye, 'tis someone I met before when 
participating in the 
Soma Nomaoi on other business. As she was 
expecting, 
I bestowed the "sacred banner" I had won 
upon her.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Rumor hath it that wrapping a sacred 
banner seized in the 
banner scramble around one's belly serveth 
as a charm for safe childbirth.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, goodness me! 
Everyone is starting to gather!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Listen well! Be sure not to take thine 
eyes off my exploits! 
Just watch meee!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...There goes No Reason-san.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Aha☆ 
Maya totally gets it now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yup, eveee-rything! 
The reason why the Soma Nomaoi changed 
form! 
And why changing times aren't the only 
reason!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, you come over here too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Mayano! 
Why are you suddenly pulling me—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because this is what matters! 
Look, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?  
What you can see from here is...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwa-ha-ha-ha! 
The one who shall claim the sacred banner 
is meee!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aah, not that way! 
Though it is hard to take your eyes off No 
Reason-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What I want everyone to see is—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, go get 'em!" "Do your best!" 
"Whoa, the banner's so high up!" "Can she 
catch it?" 
"Ooooh...!" "Magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —All these people having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely the reason! 
The reason why so many changes happened in 
the Soma Nomaoi!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because the people here were around, 
—the form of the festival changed!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—! No matter how times changed, 
there were people who wanted to keep the 
festival going—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So that's why its form changed?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because this festival became... 
so deeply intertwined with the "people" 
who lived here.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. 
...If that's the case,

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
then the reason our racing rituals used to 
take a different form 
might not be "because humans weren't 
needed back then," 
but rather...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because humans and Umamusume became deeply 
bonded 
...did it start to change?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us go claim the banner! 
The sacred banner, cloaked in prayer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the second day of the 
Soma Nomaoi came to an end.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Didst thou gain good wisdom from this?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, we learned something truly 
important.
Yes, we learned something truly important.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If humans truly were not involved 
in the racing rituals and Umamusume rites 
in the distant past,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
then what we truly ought to understand 
is the very reason why humans began to 
take part, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, No Reason-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did you bring us here knowing all of this 
along? 
Even that Maya-chan would have that flash 
of inspiration...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I merely brought everyone along 
because I sought volunteers, nothing more.
